plugins.description: Save web pages and YouTube videos, or just the parts that matter, as summarized, tagged, searchable clips in Google Drive, Notion, a Cowork project, your Claude Code project, or a private claude.ai artifact, using plain language from the Chrome side panel, the Claude Code desktop browser, or ChatGPT's connected Chrome tabs and Work browser.
